name: kanto-labs-mcp
description: Video frames, video to LLM context, scene detection, video to slides, video OCR and AI image upscaling via Kanto Labs' Apify actors.
long_description: 8 tools backed by Kanto Labs' pay-per-event actors on Apify. extract_video_frames ($0.002 per frame): Extract scene-change or evenly spaced frames from video files, with public image links, timestamps and a free contact sheet. video_to_llm_context ($0.002 per keyframe + $0.008 per audio minute): Turn a video file into AI-readable context: scene list, one keyframe per scene, Whisper transcript per scene and a ready-to-paste text block. detect_video_scenes ($0.018 per video minute (+ $0.002 per clip with splitClips)): Detect every shot in a video file: cut, dissolve and fade timecodes, keyframes, a shot sheet and CSV/JSON/EDL files, optional clips. upscale_image ($0.01 per image ($0.06 per large image with allowLargeImages)): Upscale images 2x or 4x with Real-ESRGAN (photo or anime model), transparency kept, with public download links. video_to_slides ($0.004 per slide + $0.001 per video minute): Extract every unique slide from lecture, webinar and screen-recording files as images with timestamps, slide text (OCR) and one PDF. video_ocr ($0.002 per frame with text): Extract on-screen text from video files (burned-in subtitles, captions, hook text, lower-thirds, slide text) as timed segments with a transcript and SRT/VTT. transcribe_douyin_videos ($0.004 per transcript + $0.003 per extra minute): Transcribe public Douyin (抖音) videos to punctuated Chinese text with timed segments, SRT/VTT subtitles and video metadata. search_1688_products ($0.0009 per product + $0.001 per product page + $0.0005 per image match): Search 1688.com (China wholesale) by keyword, photo or link: CNY/USD prices, MOQ, price tiers, SKUs and supplier badges. Runs are billed to your own Apify account; failures are free and every call has a spending cap.
